components.name: Text Action Link
components.description: Editorial anchor action with horizontal translate hover.
components.css: .ds-text-action-link { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #131e33; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid #131e33; padding-bottom: 3px; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-text-action-link:hover { color: #0284c7; border-color: #0284c7; transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Compile Action Button
components.description: Primary electric cyan compilation action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-compile { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; background: #0ea5e9; color: #0b1324; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-compile:hover { background: #38bdf8; }

components.name: In-DOM Compiler Pill
components.description: Floating in-DOM badge injected near chat inputs.
components.html: Clarity 96
components.css: .ds-compiler-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 11px 5px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: #0b1324; color: #fbfcfd; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #1e293b; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-compiler-pill:hover { background: #131e33; border-color: #0ea5e9; } .ds-pill-logo { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-pill-btn { background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.12); color: #38bdf8; border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3); border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 7px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill-btn:hover { background: #0ea5e9; color: #0b1324; }

components.name: Attention Filter Diff Chip
components.description: Purged conversational filler phrase chip with strikethrough.
components.css: .ds-diff-chip-removed { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #f87171; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 6px; text-decoration: line-through; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }

components.name: Enforced Bounds Chip
components.description: Hoisted negative constraint priority boundary chip.
components.html: ✓ Do NOT use external ORMs
components.css: .ds-diff-chip-promoted { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #38bdf8; background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3); border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }

components.name: Clarity Score Chip (Airtight)
components.description: Prompt clarity score status pill in optimal state.
components.css: .ds-score-chip { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }

components.name: Preset Chip
components.css: .ds-preset-btn { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border: 1px solid #1e293b; color: #8a99b0; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-preset-btn:hover { background: #131e33; color: #38bdf8; border-color: #0ea5e9; }

components.name: Terminal Output Box
components.description: Dark syntax highlighted output block for compiled contracts.
components.html: # TASK SPECIFICATION 1. Implement sub-second prompt tokenizer 2. Hoist negative boundaries
components.css: .ds-terminal-box { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; background: #060911; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #fbfcfd; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

narrative.overview: Echo treats prompt engineering not as casual conversation, but as deterministic compilation. The visual language brings the rigor of Swiss editorial design into harmony with dynamic kinetic resonance: a gallery-grade light canvas contrasted against deep marine navy and sharp geometric architectural slabs.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast gallery canvas (#fbfcfd) paired with deep marine navy (#131e33)
Editorial text hyperlinks rather than chunky button pills
Exact geometric 3-slab stepped monogram with sharp 90-degree right angles and zero connecting spine
Preview-first in-DOM compiler overlay with semantic Attention Filter and Enforced Bounds
Kinetic acoustic soundwave ripples and 3D parallax tilt

rules.name: The 5% Cyan Rule
rules.body: Resonance Cyan and Electric Blue are precision instruments, not wallpaper. They occupy less than 5% of any viewport surface to ensure compilation signals retain high attention priority.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: All text elements strictly enforce WCAG AA minimum contrast floors: >= 4.5:1 for body and small bold text, and >= 3:1 for large display elements.

rules.name: The Strict Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section kickers are always set in uppercase JetBrains Mono with 0.08em letter-spacing and primary/accent coloration.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by value contrast and 1px hairline rules, never by heavy black drop shadows.

dos: Do maintain clean gallery canvas (#fbfcfd / #ffffff) with deep marine navy (#131e33).
Do preserve the exact 3-piece geometry of the stepped 'E' monogram.
Do pair Plus Jakarta Sans with JetBrains Mono.
Do use the preview-first diff overlay before overwriting user input in browser chatboxes.
Do ensure prompt compilation happens in-DOM and in-browser with zero external latency or telemetry.
donts: Don't add generic SaaS boilerplate tropes: muddy glowing drop shadows or neon pill buttons.
Don't connect the three slabs of the 'E' monogram with a vertical spine.
Don't use centered generic blog layouts.
Don't overwrite active chatbox text without staging the preview contract or providing an instant Undo mechanism.
